brand.name: NuPhy
brand.about: NuPhy sells wireless mechanical keyboards through its own store, from low-profile Air and Node boards to QMK/VIA gasket boards and Hall effect gaming boards.

reviews.verdict: Covers the Air65 V3, Air75 V3 and Air100 V3 as one low-profile wireless series with a hot-swappable PCB for Gateron low-profile 3.0 switches.
